name: Starfall Anchorage
core_rationale: Southernmost tethered basalt sky-island of Continent 03 where bronze anchor-chains and upward waterfalls greet dimensional rift travelers arriving from The Astrolabe Rift Promontory on Continent 02.
local_conflict: Dream-glass wraiths and gravity-leech wyrms are loosening the primary starlight tether-winches that hold the anchorage level.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Upward-pouring silver cataracts at Mirror Cascade Basin have frozen the northern tether-lock; the Cartographer Guild requires the Belfry Star-Chime before unsealing the gate.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Navigators say the lighthouse bell at Starfall Anchorage rings backward three seconds before a meteor shower strikes the tether-chains.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A crescent basalt sky-island moored by glowing starlight chains above an upward-falling silver waterfall.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Where do the upward-flowing cataracts of Mirror Cascade Basin carry fallen starlight?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater and receives the Astrolabe Rift bridge from Continent 02 at Tether Causeway.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Floating basalt anchorage moored by glowing starlight chains, lantern-lit piers, and an upside-down basalt cathedral belfry.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Uses 13.5m decked tether-causeways, 0.60m chart counters, 0.14m basalt risers, and <= 0.24m star-moss for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Orthogonal 2x2 grid with Tether Causeway [0,1], Starfall Haven [1,1], Inverted Belfry Dungeon [1,1, floor -1], and Mirror Cascade Basin [1,0] (Fog of Lore) plus Level 31 to 41 spirit/construct/dragon spawns.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Mirror Cascade Basin frontier with a fog_of_lore portal and Cartographer Guild lock rationale.
